name: novasteel-presentation
description: Marp source for the NovaSteel oral-defense deck (HTML, PDF and PPTX).

scripts.html: npm run images && marp --theme theme.css --html --allow-local-files slides.md -o dist/index.html
scripts.pdf: npm run images && marp --theme theme.css --html --allow-local-files --pdf slides.md -o dist/NovaSteel-Oral-Defense.pdf
scripts.pdf-notes: npm run images && marp --theme theme.css --html --allow-local-files --pdf --pdf-notes slides.md -o dist/NovaSteel-Oral-Defense-notes.pdf
scripts.pptx: npm run images && marp --theme theme.css --html --allow-local-files --pptx slides.md -o dist/NovaSteel-Oral-Defense.pptx && node scripts/format-pptx-notes.mjs dist/NovaSteel-Oral-Defense.pptx
scripts.build: npm run html && npm run pdf && npm run pdf-notes && npm run pptx && npm run verify
